title: The California Rand Silver Mine
text: In June 1919, Williams and Nosser discovered the California Rand Silver Mine at Red Mountain. From June 1919 to August 1923, the mine produced over 7 million dollars. By 1926 its total gross production was over 13 million dollars, with dividends totaling 4.5 million. In 1929 the mine could not be operated profitably, and it was sold for 50,000 dollars.
